module_summary: Serial-to-parallel converter shifting 8 input bits into a register with counter and completion detection.

anchors.name: k
anchors.why: Bit counter tracking number of bits accumulated (0-8 cycle)

anchors.name: sh
anchors.why: Shift register accumulating serial input bits into parallel byte

anchors.name: wrap
anchors.why: Completion signal when counter reaches 8 bits

anchors.name: take
anchors.why: Enable signal for shifting new bit into accumulator

anchors.name: din_valid
anchors.why: Input valid signal indicating serial bit ready

anchors.name: din_serial
anchors.why: Serial input bit stream being accumulated

anchors.name: dout_parallel
anchors.why: Parallel output byte loaded when sequence completes

anchors.name: dout_valid
anchors.why: Output valid signal indicating parallel byte ready

anchors.name: nxt
anchors.why: Next counter value (reset on wrap or when not valid)

anchors.name: sh_mirror
anchors.why: Mirror shift register for verification or debugging

groups.name: Bit_Counter
groups.description: Counter tracking accumulated bits with wrap detection

groups.name: Shift_Accumulator
groups.description: Shift register accumulating serial input bits

groups.name: Control_Logic
groups.description: Wrap detection and shift enable control signals

groups.name: Input_Interface
groups.description: Serial input stream with valid signal

groups.name: Output_Interface
groups.description: Parallel output with completion valid signal

groups.name: Support_Registers
